reasons: The cited Article XXI is genuinely one-directional (only Licensee returns Licensor property with officer certification) and contains no transition-assistance, data-return, export or deletion mechanics, so a 'missing' classification is supportable — the document falls short of even the fallback (90 days' assistance, export within 30 days).

The insert is placed correctly as a new subsection (c) in the termination article and tracks the model language closely: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter — all three preferred elements are covered, so the edit is rule-complete.

The inline definition of 'Licensee Data' is a necessary addition because the agreement has no equivalent defined term; the obligation is triggered only 'at Licensee's request' and at Licensor's rates, so the edit is proportionate and does not overreach.
No existing text is altered (changed-character impact is purely additive) and the deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and the data-return/transition language is present.
The comment accurately explains what was added and why, cites the playbook position, and offers the 90-day fallback in the required concise first-person-plural tone with the correct prefix.
